description: Renovate opens a pull request for each new release of anything pinned here, which the owner merges (R5). The shared preset applies (zindello-cluster/cluster-platform: renovate/preset.json); this file holds only what's particular to this repo.

customManagers.description: OpenTofu's version in the workflow, kept with required_version.

packageRules.description: OpenTofu, not Terraform: providers and modules from OpenTofu's registry, and required_version is OpenTofu's own version.

required_version is OpenTofu's version, which the Terraform manager reads as hashicorp/terraform: looked up in opentofu/opentofu's releases instead. Only the package is renamed, not the dependency: renamed, Renovate re-read versions.tf after the change, found hashicorp/terraform rather than the new name, and failed every update ('update failure', cluster-02's review of 26 November 2026, B2).
OpenTofu's version, in versions.tf and the workflow, in one pull request.
